facts.fact: Law L/2016/035/AN of 26 July 2016 on electronic transactions was promulgated; ANSSI's summary says it applies to all electronic transactions including online commerce, and covers electronic signature, digital archiving, system certification, consumer information duties, fines and prison terms (the document is a summary of an image-only scan).
facts.system: Loi L/2016/035/AN relative aux transactions electroniques
